memo.full_markdown:
## Bottom Line
Independent inference vendors are gaining technical mindshare, but hyperscalers retain enterprise buying leverage [1][4][5].

## Key Movements
- Together AI and Fireworks emphasized enterprise latency and reliability wins tied to production workloads [1][2].
- Baseten pushed platform capability expansion around deployment and observability [3].
- Bedrock and Vertex improved governance-oriented controls that reduce adoption friction for large buyers [4][5].

## Competitive Dynamics
Specialists differentiate on speed, optionality, and focused developer experience, while cloud incumbents leverage integrated security, procurement, and committed-spend economics [1][4][5].

## Investor Sentiment Read
Funding and analyst coverage indicate positive sentiment for specialist leaders, though IPO readiness remains contingent on repeatable enterprise expansion metrics [2][6].

## Confidence & Risks
- Confidence score: **78/100**
- Risk: Procurement lock-in may reduce specialist conversion in Fortune 500 accounts [4][5].
- Risk: Signal quality varies across private company disclosures and reported benchmarks [1][6].
- Risk: Rapid model shifts can invalidate current differentiation narratives [1][3].

## Recommended Actions
1. Build co-sell options with top specialist platforms while preserving cloud-neutral API strategy [1][2][3].
2. Track procurement friction indicators (security review time, legal cycle length) as a leading share signal [4][5].
3. Re-run this assessment monthly with updated funding and customer evidence [2][6].

## Comparison Table
| Company | Positioning | Momentum | Investor Read |
|---|---|---|---|
| Together AI | Open and fast inference platform | Accelerating | Positive but private-market dependent [1][6] |
| Fireworks AI | Performance-focused enterprise inference | Accelerating | Strong enterprise signal mix [2] |
| Baseten | Production inference + observability | Steady | Improving narrative but still mixed [3] |
| Bedrock | Enterprise managed model layer | Steady | Backed by AWS distribution [4] |
| Vertex AI | Google-managed AI stack | Steady | Backed by Google Cloud channels [5] |

## Sources
[1] Together AI platform update
[2] Fireworks enterprise launch
[3] Baseten product release
[4] AWS Bedrock enterprise post
[5] Vertex AI roadmap
[6] Inference market investor analysis
